poses: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: transparent six-pose boss sprite source for a cheerful hand-painted children's 2D side-scrolling game. Create ONE 3-column by 2-row grid, 1536x1024 aspect, on genuine transparent alpha with generous clear gutters. Exact same child-designed character in every cell: Hole King, a plump round lavender-purple potato-like creature whose round body has six dark circular holes, two tiny rounded arms and two long thin legs, small friendly mischievous eyes and smile, a small golden crown. Soft painted watercolor texture, dark plum clear outlines, cream rim light, readable silhouette, bright and gentle, no scary teeth, no text. Design from a child's simple drawing of a round perforated creature that moves side to side. Each cell fully contains one whole character with same body scale and same foot baseline, no part crossing cell edges, no labels, no floor shadows or props outside subject. Top row left idle standing; middle warning raising both hands, holes glowing amber; right attack arms wide, leaning sideways, three small violet energy flecks strictly close to body. Bottom row left tired vulnerable crouching slightly with sleepy face and lowered arms; middle hurt recoiling with surprised face; right defeated sitting down with dizzy eyes, crown tilted. Character width at most 65% of each cell, height at most 72%; generous transparent margins. Keep entire crown, hands, feet inside cells. Do not draw checkerboard or opaque background.
bg: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: wide 2D side-scrolling children's game far background, 2048x720 aspect, full opaque image. A cheerful lavender and apricot fantasy canyon named Hole Course, playful rounded cheese-like porous rock towers and circular cave windows inspired by a child's hole-pattern drawing. Painted watercolor storybook style with dark plum soft contours matching a gentle platform game. Panoramic side-on view, distant layered rounded rock arches and tunneled hills, peach pink sky, pale cream clouds, muted turquoise shrubs, tiny gold star motifs. Interesting silhouettes across full width, far architectural detail mostly in upper and middle half, bottom quarter quiet pale lavender valley gradient for gameplay overlay. No foreground platforms, no collision floor, no gameplay holes cut into image, no characters, no bosses, no text or UI. Soft warm lighting, lively colorful inviting palette, clear calm center.
